title.zh: 授权菲律宾总统动用1949财年总拨款法行政部门节余，运营现有及增设的师范学校，并修复、扩建哥打巴托乌皮农业学校、布基农农业学校、阿布拉拉甘吉朗农场学校与伊莎贝拉卡巴甘农场学校的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the President of the Philippines to Use Any Savings from the Appropriations for the Executive Department in the General Appropriation Act for the Fiscal Year Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Nine for the Operation of All Existing Normal Schools, for the Establishment and Operation of Additional Normal Schools, and for the Rehabilitation and Expansion of the Upi Agricultural School in Cotabato, the Bukidnon Agricultural School in Bukidnon, the Lagangilang Farm School in Abra and the Cabagan Farm School in Isabela
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the President of the Philippines to Use Any Savings from the Appropriations for the Executive Department in the General Appropriation Act for the Fiscal Year Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Nine for the Operation of All Existing Normal Schools, for the Establishment and Operation of Additional Normal Schools, and for the Rehabilitation and Expansion of the Upi Agricultural School in Cotabato, the Bukidnon Agricultural School in Bukidnon, the Lagangilang Farm School in Abra and the Cabagan Farm School in Isabela

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_336_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provisions in the General Appropriation Act for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and forty-nine to the contrary notwithstanding, the President of the Philippines is authorized to use any savings from the appropriations for the Executive Department in the said Act for the following purposes: (1) operating all existing normal schools, including the payment of salaries of teachers and other personnel, the purchase of equipment, and for other necessary expenses; (2) establishing and operating additional normal schools, including the purchase and/or expropriation of sites, the construction of buildings, the payment of salaries of teachers and other personnel, the purchase of equipment, and for other necessary expenses; and (3) rehabilitating and expanding the activities of the Upi Agricultural School in Cotabato, the Bukidnon Agricultural School in Bukidnon, the Lagangilang Farm School in Abra and the Cabagan Farm School in Isabela, including the purchase of tractors, motor fuel, and draft and breeding animals.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: July 20, 1948.
